subject: Mobile Development
title: No Sideloading on iOS
description: A quick win: understand No Sideloading on iOS.

hook.text: On Android, you can install any app from any source. On iOS, you can't.

buildup.text: Apple blocks all app installation outside the App Store to maintain security.

discovery.text: Jailbreaking bypasses this restriction but voids warranties and introduces security risks.

twist.text: The EU's Digital Markets Act now forces Apple to allow sideloading in Europe.

climax.text: Sideloading is the most contentious battle between user freedom and platform security.

punchline.text: Europe forced Apple to unlock its gate.

quiz.question: What legislation forced Apple to allow sideloading?
